CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_stores(p_business_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare result jsonb;
begin
 if auth.uid() is null or not exists(select 1 from public.businesses b where
 (p_business_id is null or b.id=p_business_id) and (public.is_owner_of_account(b.account_id) or public.is_admin_of(b.id))) then
 raise exception 'not an administrator of business' using errcode='42501'; end if;
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(row_data order by row_data->>'name'),'[]'::jsonb) into result from (
 select jsonb_build_object('id',b.id,'account_id',b.account_id,'name',b.pharmacy_name,'ncpdp',b.ncpdp,'npi',b.npi,'status',b.status,
 'member_count',(select count(*) from public.user_businesses ub where ub.business_id=b.id))
 || case when public.is_owner_of_account(b.account_id) then jsonb_build_object(
 'subscription_status',(select s.status from public.subscriptions s where s.account_id=b.account_id order by s.created_at desc,s.id limit 1))
 else '{}'::jsonb end row_data
 from public.businesses b where (p_business_id is null or b.id=p_business_id)
 and (public.is_owner_of_account(b.account_id) or public.is_admin_of(b.id))) scoped;
 insert into public.audit_logs(actor_user_id,actor_role,business_id,table_name,action,context)
 values(auth.uid(),'authenticated',p_business_id,'businesses','read_page',jsonb_build_object('fn','admin_stores'));
 return result;
end; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handoff_claim(p_code_hash bytea, p_verifier text, p_state_hash bytea, p_dest text, p_env text)
 RETURNS TABLE(outcome text, claim_id uuid, user_id uuid, return_path text, attempt smallint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_challenge text := rtrim(translate(encode(sha256(convert_to(p_verifier, 'UTF8')), 'base64'), '+/', '-_'), '=');
begin
  return query
  update handoff.codes c
     set claimed_at = now()
   where c.code_hash   = p_code_hash
     and c.challenge   = v_challenge          -- explicit destination verifier validation (S256)
     and c.state_hash  = p_state_hash         -- browser binding
     and c.dest_app    = p_dest               -- audience
     and c.environment = p_env
     and c.claimed_at is null                 -- single redemption
     and c.invalidated_at is null
     and c.expires_at > now()
     and exists (select 1 from auth.sessions s
                 where s.id = c.source_session_id and s.user_id = c.user_id)   -- source still signed in
  returning 'claimed', c.id, c.user_id, c.return_path, c.attempt;
  if not found then
    return query select 'rejected'::text, null::uuid, null::uuid, null::text, null::smallint;
  end if;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handoff_complete(p_claim_id uuid, p_dest_session uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  update handoff.codes c
     set completed_at = now(), dest_session_id = p_dest_session
   where c.id = p_claim_id
     and c.claimed_at is not null
     and c.completed_at is null
     and c.invalidated_at is null
     and exists (select 1 from auth.sessions s
                 where s.id = c.source_session_id and s.user_id = c.user_id);
  if found then return 'ok'; end if;
  return 'revoked';
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handoff_fail(p_claim_id uuid, p_reason text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  update handoff.codes set invalidated_at = now(), invalid_reason = p_reason
   where id = p_claim_id and completed_at is null and invalidated_at is null;
$function$

functions.args: p_user uuid, p_session uuid, p_source text, p_dest text, p_env text, p_challenge text, p_state_hash bytea, p_return text, p_code_hash bytea, p_attempt smallint
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handoff_issue(p_user uuid, p_session uuid, p_source text, p_dest text, p_env text, p_challenge text, p_state_hash bytea, p_return text, p_code_hash bytea, p_attempt smallint)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if not exists (select 1 from auth.sessions s where s.id = p_session and s.user_id = p_user) then
    return 'source_signed_out';
  end if;
  if (select count(*) from handoff.codes c
      where c.user_id = p_user and c.created_at > now() - interval '60 seconds') >= 10 then
    return 'slow_down';
  end if;
  delete from handoff.codes where id in (
    select c.id from handoff.codes c
     where c.created_at < now() - interval '24 hours'
       and (c.completed_at is not null or c.invalidated_at is not null or c.expires_at < now())
     limit 100);
  insert into handoff.codes (code_hash, challenge, state_hash, user_id, source_session_id,
                             source_app, dest_app, environment, return_path, attempt, expires_at)
  values (p_code_hash, p_challenge, p_state_hash, p_user, p_session,
          p_source, p_dest, p_env, p_return, p_attempt, now() + interval '60 seconds');
  return 'issued';
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.npi_bind(p_draft uuid, p_operation uuid, p_checkout_expires timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 update public.npi_reservations x
    set status = 'checkout_bound', operation_id = p_operation, expires_at = p_checkout_expires + interval '5 minutes'
  where x.draft_id = p_draft and x.status in ('held','checkout_bound')
    and (x.operation_id is null or x.operation_id = p_operation)
    and exists (select 1 from public.checkout_operations o where o.id = p_operation and o.draft_id = p_draft and o.npi = x.npi);
 if found then return 'bound'; end if;
 return 'no_reservation';
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.npi_release_unpaid(p_operation uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if not exists (select 1 from public.checkout_operations o where o.id = p_operation and o.status = 'expired_unpaid') then
  return 'not_proven_unpaid'; end if;
 update public.npi_reservations x set status = 'released'
  where x.operation_id = p_operation and x.status in ('held','checkout_bound');
 if found then return 'released'; end if;
 return 'nothing_to_release';
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.operation_lease(p_operation uuid, p_owner text, p_seconds integer)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 update public.checkout_operations o
    set lease_owner = p_owner, lease_expires_at = now() + make_interval(secs => least(greatest(p_seconds, 5), 120)),
        attempts = o.attempts + 1
  where o.id = p_operation
    and (o.lease_owner is null or o.lease_owner = p_owner or o.lease_expires_at <= now());
 return found;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.owedbook_kpis(p_business_id uuid, p_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_to date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_pbms text[] DEFAULT '{}'::text[], p_filter text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(commercial_underpaid numeric, commercial_scripts bigint, updated_difference numeric, owed numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  -- 1. membership (R-4): junction membership via the DEFINER set helper; NULL is not a member
  if p_business_id is null or not (p_business_id in (select public.my_business_ids())) then
    raise exception 'not a member of business';
  end if;

  -- 2. log-then-return (R-7): exactly one read_page row per call
  insert into public.audit_logs
    (actor_user_id, actor_role, business_id, table_name, row_id, action, old_data, new_data, context)
  values (
    auth.uid(),
    coalesce(nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'role', current_user::text),
    p_business_id, 'user_data', null, 'read_page', null, null,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'fn',      'owedbook_kpis',
      'args',    jsonb_build_object('p_business_id', p_business_id, 'p_from', p_from, 'p_to', p_to,
                                    'p_pbms', to_jsonb(p_pbms), 'p_filter', p_filter),
      'filters', jsonb_build_object('from', p_from, 'to', p_to, 'pbms', to_jsonb(p_pbms), 'filter', p_filter)
    )
  );

  -- 3. the read — explicit tenant fence, stored columns only
  return query
    select
      round(coalesce(sum(ud.owed) filter (where ud.owed > 0), 0), 2)::numeric,
      count(*)::bigint,
      round(coalesce(sum(ud.difference), 0), 2)::numeric,
      round(coalesce(sum(ud.owed) filter (where ud.owed > 0), 0), 2)::numeric
    from public.user_data ud
    where ud.business_id = p_business_id
      and (p_from   is null or ud.date_dispensed >= p_from)
      and (p_to     is null or ud.date_dispensed <= p_to)
      and (coalesce(array_length(p_pbms, 1), 0) = 0 or ud.insurance = any (p_pbms))
      and (p_filter is null or ud.status = p_filter);
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.owedbook_pbm_options(p_business_id uuid)
 RETURNS SETOF text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  -- 1. membership (R-4)
  if p_business_id is null or not (p_business_id in (select public.my_business_ids())) then
    raise exception 'not a member of business';
  end if;

  -- 2. log-then-return (R-7)
  insert into public.audit_logs
    (actor_user_id, actor_role, business_id, table_name, row_id, action, old_data, new_data, context)
  values (
    auth.uid(),
    coalesce(nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'role', current_user::text),
    p_business_id, 'user_data', null, 'read_page', null, null,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'fn',   'owedbook_pbm_options',
      'args', jsonb_build_object('p_business_id', p_business_id)
    )
  );

  -- 3. the read — explicit tenant fence
  return query
    select distinct ud.insurance::text
    from public.user_data ud
    where ud.business_id = p_business_id
      and ud.insurance is not null
    order by 1;
end;
$function$

functions.args: p_business_id uuid, p_tab text, p_from date, p_to date, p_pbms text[], p_filter text, p_page integer, p_limit integer
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.owedbook_rows(p_business_id uuid, p_tab text, p_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_to date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_pbms text[] DEFAULT '{}'::text[], p_filter text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_page integer DEFAULT 1, p_limit integer DEFAULT 25)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_limit      integer := greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 25), 1);
  v_req_page   integer := greatest(coalesce(p_page, 1), 1);
  v_total      bigint;
  v_page_count integer;
  v_page       integer;
  v_offset     integer;
  v_rows       jsonb;
begin
  -- 1. membership (R-4)
  if p_business_id is null or not (p_business_id in (select public.my_business_ids())) then
    raise exception 'not a member of business';
  end if;
  if p_tab is null or p_tab not in ('commercial_dollars', 'updated_commercial_payments', 'federal_dollars', 'summary') then
    raise exception 'unknown tab: %', p_tab;
  end if;

  -- 2. log-then-return (R-7): one row per call, not per row returned — and BEFORE any read
  --    (Brief §5). The row carries the REQUESTED page/limit/offset; the page actually served
  --    after clamping (owedbook.ts:95-98) is in the returned envelope.
  insert into public.audit_logs
    (actor_user_id, actor_role, business_id, table_name, row_id, action, old_data, new_data, context)
  values (
    auth.uid(),
    coalesce(nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'role', current_user::text),
    p_business_id, 'user_data', null, 'read_page', null, null,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'fn',      'owedbook_rows',
      'args',    jsonb_build_object('p_business_id', p_business_id, 'p_tab', p_tab, 'p_from', p_from, 'p_to', p_to,
                                    'p_pbms', to_jsonb(p_pbms), 'p_filter', p_filter, 'p_page', p_page, 'p_limit', p_limit),
      'page',    v_req_page,
      'limit',   v_limit,
      'offset',  (v_req_page - 1) * v_limit,
      'filters', jsonb_build_object('from', p_from, 'to', p_to, 'pbms', to_jsonb(p_pbms), 'filter', p_filter, 'tab', p_tab)
    )
  );

  -- 3. the read — pager arithmetic (owedbook.ts:95-98), then the page; explicit tenant fence
  select count(*) into v_total
  from public.user_data ud
  where ud.business_id = p_business_id
    and (p_from   is null or ud.date_dispensed >= p_from)
    and (p_to     is null or ud.date_dispensed <= p_to)
    and (coalesce(array_length(p_pbms, 1), 0) = 0 or ud.insurance = any (p_pbms))
    and (p_filter is null or ud.status = p_filter)
    and (p_tab <> 'updated_commercial_payments' or ud.new_paid is not null)
    and (p_tab <> 'federal_dollars');                       -- federal_expected is NULL in v1 (A-3)
  v_page_count := greatest(1, ceil(v_total::numeric / v_limit)::integer);
  v_page       := least(v_req_page, v_page_count);
  v_offset     := (v_page - 1) * v_limit;

  -- OwedBookRow shape per A-3
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(r.row_obj), '[]'::jsonb) into v_rows
  from (
    select jsonb_build_object(
             'id',                 ud.id::text,
             'date',               ud.date_dispensed,
             'script',             ud.script,
             'qty',                ud.qty,
             'pbm',                ud.insurance,
             'status',             ud.status,
             'report_file',        null::text,
             'original_paid',      ud.total_paid,
             'medicaid_rate',      ud.medicaid_rate,
             'method',             ud.medicaid_method,
             'expected',           ud.expected_paid,
             'owed',               ud.owed,
             'new_paid',           ud.new_paid,
             'updated_difference', ud.difference,
             'aac',                null::numeric,
             'federal_expected',   null::numeric,
             'federal_diff',       null::numeric
           ) as row_obj
    from public.user_data ud
    where ud.business_id = p_business_id
      and (p_from   is null or ud.date_dispensed >= p_from)
      and (p_to     is null or ud.date_dispensed <= p_to)
      and (coalesce(array_length(p_pbms, 1), 0) = 0 or ud.insurance = any (p_pbms))
      and (p_filter is null or ud.status = p_filter)
      and (p_tab <> 'updated_commercial_payments' or ud.new_paid is not null)
      and (p_tab <> 'federal_dollars')
    order by ud.date_dispensed desc nulls last, ud.id
    offset v_offset limit v_limit
  ) r;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'rows',      v_rows,
    'page',      v_page,
    'pageCount', v_page_count,
    'limit',     v_limit,
    'total',     v_total
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.owedbook_summary(p_business_id uuid, p_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_to date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_pbms text[] DEFAULT '{}'::text[], p_filter text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(pbm text, commercial_dollars numeric, federal_dollars numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  -- 1. membership (R-4)
  if p_business_id is null or not (p_business_id in (select public.my_business_ids())) then
    raise exception 'not a member of business';
  end if;

  -- 2. log-then-return (R-7)
  insert into public.audit_logs
    (actor_user_id, actor_role, business_id, table_name, row_id, action, old_data, new_data, context)
  values (
    auth.uid(),
    coalesce(nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'role', current_user::text),
    p_business_id, 'user_data', null, 'read_page', null, null,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'fn',      'owedbook_summary',
      'args',    jsonb_build_object('p_business_id', p_business_id, 'p_from', p_from, 'p_to', p_to,
                                    'p_pbms', to_jsonb(p_pbms), 'p_filter', p_filter),
      'filters', jsonb_build_object('from', p_from, 'to', p_to, 'pbms', to_jsonb(p_pbms), 'filter', p_filter)
    )
  );

  -- 3. the read — explicit tenant fence, grouped by PBM (insurance, A-3)
  return query
    select
      ud.insurance::text,
      round(coalesce(sum(ud.owed) filter (where ud.owed > 0), 0), 2)::numeric,
      0::numeric                                            -- federal_diff is NULL in v1 (A-3)
    from public.user_data ud
    where ud.business_id = p_business_id
      and ud.insurance is not null
      and (p_from   is null or ud.date_dispensed >= p_from)
      and (p_to     is null or ud.date_dispensed <= p_to)
      and (coalesce(array_length(p_pbms, 1), 0) = 0 or ud.insurance = any (p_pbms))
      and (p_filter is null or ud.status = p_filter)
    group by ud.insurance
    order by 2 desc, 1;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.subscription_grace_clear(p_stripe_subscription_id text, p_invoice text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 update public.subscriptions s set grace_started_at = null
  where s.stripe_subscription_id = p_stripe_subscription_id and s.origin = 'stripe'
    and s.grace_invoice_id = p_invoice and s.grace_started_at is not null;
 if found then return 'cleared'; end if;

 LANGUAGE plpgsql

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.subscription_mirror_apply(p_stripe_subscription_id text, p jsonb, p_verified_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 update public.subscriptions s set
   raw_status = p->>'raw_status',
   status = p->>'status',
   quantity = (p->>'quantity')::integer,
   stripe_price_id = p->>'price_id',
   stripe_subscription_item_id = p->>'item_id',
   current_period_start = (p->>'current_period_start')::timestamptz,
   current_period_end = (p->>'current_period_end')::timestamptz,
   cancel_at_period_end = coalesce((p->>'cancel_at_period_end')::boolean, false),
   cancel_at = (p->>'cancel_at')::timestamptz,
   latest_invoice_id = p->>'latest_invoice_id',
   latest_invoice_status = p->>'latest_invoice_status',
   verified_at = p_verified_at
  where s.stripe_subscription_id = p_stripe_subscription_id and s.origin = 'stripe'
    and (s.verified_at is null or s.verified_at <= p_verified_at)
    and (s.status is distinct from 'canceled' or p->>'status' = 'canceled');
 if found then return 'applied'; end if;
 if exists (select 1 from public.subscriptions s where s.stripe_subscription_id = p_stripe_subscription_id) then return 'stale'; end if;
 return 'unknown_subscription';
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tenant_stores()
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, account_id uuid, name text, capability text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select b.id,b.account_id,b.pharmacy_name,
 case when public.is_owner_of_account(b.account_id) then 'owner'
      when public.is_admin_of(b.id) then 'admin' else 'member' end
 from public.businesses b where b.id in(select public.my_business_ids()) order by b.pharmacy_name,b.id;
$function$
